candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 unhandled request failures (9 occurrences) with error_rate 0.16 and p95 440ms; gateway's call to order errors at 919ms and order's checkout span errors at 1350ms, indicating order-side 500s drive the checkout error-rate and latency alert.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order 500s is not established; db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts are 0, so pool exhaustion and dependency timeouts are not supported.

report.explanation: Order service shows elevated error_rate (0.16), p95 440ms, and 9 unhandled 500 failures; gateway and order traces both error on the checkout path. Gateway itself is healthy (error_rate 0.0012, p95 78ms). Pool waiters and dependency timeouts are zero, so db-pool-exhaustion and redis-timeout are unsupported. Deployment record alone cannot establish causation. Bounded candidate: order-side HTTP 500s.
missing_evidence: Order error log stack traces or exception types to identify the failing code path behind the 500s
Order dependency-level latency/error metrics (inventory, payment, postgresql) to rule out downstream latency
Order deployment change details beyond version to assess whether 3.3.7 introduced the failures
